<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FindJob"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ConfirmationReceived" name="Application receipt confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_NewJobOffer" name="New job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_InterviewNegotiation" name="Interview negotiation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_EmploymentOffer" name="Employment offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyRatesApplicant" name="Company rating of applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobBecomesPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ConfirmationToApplicant" name="Confirm receipt and rate application" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_ApplicationConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NegotiationToCompany" name="Negotiate interview" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EmploymentOfferToApplicant" name="Company wants you to work for them" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_EmploymentOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RatingToCompany" name="Rate company" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CompanyRatingToApplicant" name="Company rates you" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PermanentToApplicant" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_JobBecomesPermanent"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job (applicant)" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_JobSearch" name="Job search started"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SearchMerge" name="Continue job search"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteApplication" name="Write job application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApplication" name="Report company of application"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitResponse" name="Await company response or new offer" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ApplicationConfirmed" name="Application receipt confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ApplicationConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_ConfirmationReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NewJobOffer" name="New job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NewJobOffer" messageRef="Msg_NewJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewOutcome" name="Company wants to hire?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EmploymentOffer" name="Employment offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_EmploymentOffer" messageRef="Msg_EmploymentOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="Subprocess_Probation" name="Probation phase">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Probation"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WorkProbation" name="Work probation phase"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Probation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationStart" sourceRef="Start_Probation" targetRef="Task_WorkProbation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationEnd" sourceRef="Task_WorkProbation" targetRef="End_Probation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterProbation" name="After probation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant" name="Company rating received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyRatesApplicant" messageRef="Msg_CompanyRatesApplicant"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_JobBecomesPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JobBecomesPermanent" messageRef="Msg_JobBecomesPermanent"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingCheck" name="Company rated C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Continue receiving offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferContinue" name="New job offer received (no reporting)">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferContinue" messageRef="Msg_NewJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYearPassed" name="One year after probation">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ViewReviews" name="View company reviews"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewsViewed" name="Company reviews viewed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Hired" name="Job search ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_JobSearch" targetRef="Gateway_SearchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Gateway_SearchMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_WriteApplication" targetRef="Task_ReportApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplication" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_ApplicationConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_NewJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Event_ApplicationConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_SearchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Event_NewJobOffer" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewOutcome" targetRef="Event_EmploymentOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_SearchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Event_EmploymentOffer" targetRef="Subprocess_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Subprocess_Probation" targetRef="Gateway_AfterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterProbation" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterProbation" targetRef="Event_OneYearPassed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Event_OneYearPassed" targetRef="Task_ViewReviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ViewReviews" targetRef="End_ReviewsViewed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant" targetRef="Event_JobBecomesPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Event_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_RatingCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" name="Rated C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingCheck" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" name="Rated above C" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingCheck" targetRef="End_Hired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferContinue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Event_OfferContinue" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
